data.description: Empty element that gets filled with an estimated reading time (e.g. '5 min read'). Counts words inside `data-aed-rt-scope`, stripping nav/footer/aside/script/style.

data-aed-rt-scope.description: CSS selector for the prose container the addon should count words inside.

data-aed-rt-wpm.description: Words per minute used for the estimate.

data-aed-rt-min.description: Minimum minute count to display (estimates below this round up).

data-aed-rt-format.description: Output template. `{n}` is the minute count.
